answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tier trust like a terrace: each new identity starts on the lowest terrace with tiny work quotas, and only verified, paid work moves it up. Every identity must post a refundable bond in a slow-release escrow; like water seeping through karst, the bond returns only after months of honest service, so cloning a thousand identities means locking a thousand bonds. Each fraud burns the bond and stains linked identities, so the ripple of one detected fake raises the cost of the next clone until mass forgery is unprofitable.
